Form -V
CERTIFICATE
(Given by the Registrar, UET, Lahore)
It is to certify that Mr. / Mrs.
Father/Mother of applicant
has been a full-time employee of the University from
to
as
in the
department/branch.
He/She has continuously served the university for a period not less than five years (being physically present in the university during the period)
Further certified that he/she
a)
did not leave the university service by resigning and
b)
was not dismissed, removed or debarred from the University service under its Efficiency and Discipline Rules
c)
has not been transferred to the University of Engineering and Technology, Taxila.
Signature of the
Registrar
Dated:
